sequences.query:
activity_type:"process_create" AND ( (process_command_line:"date " AND process_command_line:"-s")  OR  (process_command_line:"timedatectl " AND process_command_line:"set-time")  OR  process_command_line:"hwclock --set"  OR
  process_command_line:"hwclock -w"  OR  process_command_line:"ntpdate "  OR  (process_command_line:"chronyc " AND process_command_line:"makestep")) AND NOT user="root" AND NOT parent_process_name:"puppet" AND NOT parent_process_name:"chef"
AND NOT parent_process_name:"ansible"AND NOT parent_process_name:"salt"
